profile_text.body:
Humane Intelligence is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded in 2022 and headquartered in Katy, Texas. On its own site it describes itself as dedicated to breaking down barriers to AI deployment for social good, and says it collaboratively designs and runs evaluations intended to make AI systems more accountable, responsible, and fair.

The organization describes several service lines. AI red teaming is offered as a paid service using its own software, which it says was released under an open source license in September 2026. It also designs and runs contextual evaluations as a paid service, described as mixed-method and bespoke, and says it is developing ontology-based contextual AI evaluations, or OB-CAIE, in 2026. Bias bounties are described as collaboratively designed challenge sets bringing together researchers, impacted communities, and domain experts; its final self-hosted bias bounty closed in November 2025, and in August 2026 it launched its first bias bounty on Zindi, which it describes as a global data science challenge platform. A web application built for data collection at hosted red teaming events and for contextual evaluation services was released as open source in September 2026, with new client-facing software stated as available in October 2026. The site invites inquiries about hiring and pricing through an email address and a contact form.

The record holds no lawsuits involving the company. Its recorded law exposure is in Texas.
